items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: No, Slick Jones is now working there....

ctx.x: time they raided the whole show, took all the actors to jail, because they were doing something on the stage... We have to check that out.

All right, in six months, I had been in the Nest Club, the Rhythm Club, I'd been on Broadway -- and I'm back in the Nest Club again. And up over the Nest Club, Smitty... No, Slick Jones is now working there....
Slick Jones was a drummer, too.
